title: Bluegate Business Storage Account Parcel Receiving Standards
content:
For the Bluegate Business Storage Account, parcel receiving standards set, per program, whether the facility signs for parcels on the business's behalf, how many parcels a calendar month are accepted at no charge, the fee for each parcel beyond that allowance, the heaviest parcel accepted, and which kinds of delivery are accepted.

## Standards table

| Program | Facility signs for parcels | Parcels accepted per calendar month at no charge | Fee per parcel beyond the monthly allowance | Heaviest parcel accepted | Deliveries needing a signature | Hazardous materials | Perishables |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bluegate Business Essentials | No | 0 | $0.00 | 0 lb (not offered) | Not accepted | Not accepted | Not accepted |
| Bluegate Business Plus | Yes | 20 | $2.50 | 50 lb | Accepted | Not accepted | Not accepted |
| Bluegate Business Pro | Yes | 60 | $2.00 | 70 lb | Accepted | Not accepted | Not accepted |
| Bluegate Business Logistics | Yes | 100 | $1.50 | 150 lb | Accepted | Not accepted | Not accepted |
| Bluegate Business Fleet | Yes | 30 | $2.00 | 70 lb | Accepted | Not accepted | Not accepted |
| Bluegate Business National Account | Yes | 250 | $1.25 | 150 lb | Accepted | Not accepted | Not accepted |

## Notes on the standards

- Bluegate Business Essentials does not include delivery acceptance; its allowance, fee and weight figures are all zero for that reason.
- No program accepts hazardous materials or perishables.
- Fleet's allowance (30) is lower than Pro's (60), although the fee per extra parcel is the same $2.00 on both.

## Allowance illustrations (hypothetical)

| Program | Parcels received in one calendar month (hypothetical) | Parcels within the allowance | Parcels beyond it | Charge for parcels beyond it |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bluegate Business Plus | 24 | 20 | 4 | 4 at $2.50, $10.00 |
| Bluegate Business Fleet | 30 | 30 | 0 | $0.00 |
| Bluegate Business Logistics | 104 | 100 | 4 | 4 at $1.50, $6.00 |
